geographicReview.notes: Directed five-arch alignment and curved bank wings were reviewed in all four current production terrain frames. With the model origin at 27.40 m NGF-IGN69, road endpoints are approximately 35.45/35.56 m, agreeing with independent upper-bank samples 35.4/35.6 m and the official BD TOPO 3D road within its stated 1.5 m vertical accuracy. Rays 0.5 m inside the modeled ends retain 0.62/0.41 m residuals because the 3 m terrain grid interpolates the sharp quay edge; no terrain fitting or flattening was applied. All five openings remain visible and the banks support the modeled ends. Represented normal water 28.50 m differs from the preserved RGE ALTI water surface 28.05 m by 0.45 m; these are different water/reference states, not a measured datum conversion. Host terrain must use NGF-IGN69 or explicitly convert heights. Underwater footings remain a reconstruction, not a bathymetric survey. Current production captures additionally include the independent BD TOPO bridge and bank-road plans: only bridge-tagged covered fragments disappear, both road approaches meet the modeled ends, and lower quay roads remain visible under the outer arches. The native 166-point wing/deck outline is exact; connector stations approximate asymmetric endpoint locations by 2.65 m with less than 5 cm native profile difference. Rechecked all eight terrain/road frames after the crowned sidewalk repair; its source and report hashes are bound here.

visualReview.notes: All 20 current portable frames inspected, including full-resolution quay wall, soffit, plaques and lettering. Five unequal open vaults, angularly matched soffit backing, radial voussoirs, staggered ashlar curved wings, round cutwaters, dentil cornices, open capsule balustrades, cast lanterns and current lane markings render. Earlier intersecting vault backing, missing quay joints, and the sidewalk surface cutting through the center vault are corrected; sidewalk strips now follow the nonlinear road crown. Fine mortar joints alias at distance.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All 19 current shared viewer frames inspected, including full-resolution soffit and center-arch views. The flat surface cutting across the vault is gone. Four shared surface graphs load once each and unload disposes all live model geometry. Limestone variation and carved openings remain legible. Extended approach bounds select standalone asset review; independent production terrain and road placement are reviewed in separate geographic reports.

fidelityReview.notes: 795,350-triangle individually researched exterior reviewed against current road/railing photographs, 1982 ministry description, Séjourné rise table, mapped cutwaters and aerial, and archival/current memorial photographs. Curved bank wings, staggered masonry, open balustrades, lanterns, drains, readable paired memorials and bridge-name molding are modeled. The published 168 m nominal length conflicts with mapped pier spacings and published clear spans; the model follows those mapped piers and clear spans, producing a 172.6 m vault chain. This is an explicit source discrepancy, not a claim of construction-survey precision. Quay stairs outside the recorded bridge footprint are outside the asset; exact lantern and inscription dimensions remain photograph-based reconstruction.
